name: N3XRA Project Pulse

summary.statement: N3XRA is a connected technology platform comprising approximately 141,000 lines of source code across customer experiences, software products, APIs, database systems, administrative tools, and operational infrastructure.

products.name: Websites & Client Services
products.summary: Custom websites, project intake, proposals, onboarding, delivery, billing, and ongoing client service.

products.name: N3XRA Records

products.name: N3XRA Utilities

products.name: N3XRA Virals

products.name: AI Music Generator

products.name: N3XRA Partners
products.summary: Partner applications, referrals, commissions, attribution, onboarding, reporting, and administration.

products.name: N3XRA Company Platform
products.summary: Shared identity, customer dashboards, billing, support, notifications, governance planning, and platform administration.
